Hollis's address is internal (hmbeki@pemberline.com), so Ruth's approval for outside addresses doesn't come into it.

**What I did:**
- **Logged the approval request** naming June as the approver.
- **Asked June by DM** whether I can save the draft.
- **Replied to Marcus in our DM.** I explained the hold-up and showed the text I'll save once June approves:

  - Subject: Thornbury 2027 rate
  - Body: gives the $2,101 proposed 2027 per-seat rate for the territory review, notes it came from Marcus's call yesterday, and says it isn't in any document yet.

**What I couldn't check:** No Thornbury files are visible to me, and GBrain has no Thornbury notes. So I couldn't confirm that Marcus owns the account. That doesn't change anything here, since Hollis needs approval either way.

When June replies, I'll save the draft to Marcus's mailbox for Marcus to send.
